description:
[read-only] One lead from the inbox with its stage history. `source` is meta (default, the Meta lead id) or site (a site form lead id). Read-only.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/leads/{leadId}.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) to see one brand's leads. Omitted: every lead the key owner receives. A brand-bound key is pinned to its brand.

leadId.description: The Meta lead id (leadgen id), or a site form lead id with source=site.

source.description: meta (Meta lead ads) or site (the flayr.social form; flayr staff only).

name: ads_lead_get
title: Read a lead
